name: Enkan no Memoria
source:
The Gods from the faraway Kingdom of Heaven, and the Gods who inhabit the earthly world, populated by humans. There are gods of wind, fire, earth and water - Gods that dwell within nature. There are Gods that dwell in tools, and human and animal souls that have been enshrined, thus reaching divinity.
Gods have inhabited his country since times immemorial. And now, in this era, beside us we may find a new kind of Gods, born in order to protect us. The very fruit of human knowledge: Manufactured Gods.
──We humans have finally created Gods with our very own hands.

Whilst still feeling the heat of summer, the protagonist, Katsuki Sayu, moves back to the town of Shiraki where she grew up in with her older brother, Katsuki Minato.
"It's a hazy memory, but I sort of remember the streets..."
Sayu walks down the street, submerged in nostalgia. Because of the shock her parents' death caused her, her memories from the past are very vague. This made her very uneasy, but after living with her gentle brother and supporting each other, Sayu decided to treasure her present and her future, and not force herself to remember her past.

A week after Sayu moves, when she has finally adapted herself to life in this town and in her new school, a transfer student arrives at Shiraki Academy one day. And he instantly walks up to Sayu──

"We finally meet... I'm a Manufactured God from the Haruki Shrine! In order to take back my powers, I need your lost memories! Please help me search for them!"
This mysterious young man who calls himself a Manufactured God, Katsuki Ren, informs Sayu that they met when they were young, and that both her memories and his powers as a God were sealed away.

Blank memories──

The story in search for the lost shards of her memories hereby begins...

[Translated from the official site, from [url=http://kirakiratreasurebox.blogspot.com.es/2016/06/2016-22-pc-otome-game-schedule.html]Kira Kira Treasure Box[/url]]
translation:
遥远天界王国的神明，以及栖息在人类尘世的神明，共同构成了这个世界。有掌管风、火、土与水的神明，寄宿在自然之中；也有寄宿于工具中的神，以及被供奉后获得神性的人的灵魂与动物的灵魂。

神明自远古以来便居住在这个国家。如今，在这个时代，我们身边又出现了一种为了保护人类而诞生的新神明——人类知识的结晶：人造神。
──人类终于亲手创造出了神。

夏日余热尚未散尽，主人公香月纱由回到了与哥哥香月凑一同长大的白木镇。

“记忆很模糊，但我好像记得这些街道……”

纱由走在街上，沉浸于怀旧之情。父母去世的冲击让她过去的记忆十分模糊，这令她焦虑不安。可与温柔的哥哥共同生活、互相扶持后，纱由决定珍惜现在和未来，不再强迫自己回忆过去。

纱由搬来一周后，她终于适应了小镇和新学校的生活。某天，一名转学生来到白木学园，并径直走向纱由──

“我们终于见面了……我是春木神社的人造神！为了取回力量，我需要你失去的记忆！请帮我寻找它们！”

自称人造神的神秘少年香月莲告诉纱由，两人小时候曾见过面，而她的记忆与他作为神的力量都被封印了。

空白的记忆──

寻找失落记忆碎片的故事，就此开始……
